_readme: Fill this in to put your name on the site: the home page "Who's behind it" card, the footer About link and the About page (which also becomes searchable). The "Bake proof" GitHub action writes it into the pages. name: your name. photo: a square photo, e.g. "site/img/founder.jpg" (about 600 x 600). story: three sentences on why you built it, in your own words (blank line between paragraphs). links: one profile, e.g. [{ "label": "X", "url": "https://x.com/you" }] or YouTube or LinkedIn.
role: Founder, makes his own reels with Reel Studio
